support.quote: The final was the shortest major final of the Open Era; the official duration of the match was 34 minutes, with only 32 minutes of play due to a rain break.
Once every four years, the game’s greats now had something even grander than the Grand Slam to chase.

assessments.note: a Golden Slam needs Olympic gold in the same calendar year as the four majors, and the Olympics come every four years (exception: Tokyo 2020 held in 2021)
